meta.generated_by: hand-authored companion; consumed by pipeline/build_provenance.py (deterministic, network-free)
meta.label: Sidecar provenance manifest for platform/data/ layers that cannot practically carry an inline `meta` block: top-level JSON arrays (which structurally cannot), and the large network-pulled geometry families (every <slug>_catchment.json). build_provenance.py consults this file — a stamp key is an exact relpath OR a glob (e.g. `*_catchment.json`) that stamps a whole family — so those layers leave the shame board without a breaking {meta,data} restructure that every consumer would have to change.
meta.provenance: measured — a provenance manifest of committed files; nothing here is invented
meta.source: Describes the provenance of the named array-shaped files ONLY. Carries no data values and no numbers — pure provenance description. Each entry's verdict is read from its own stamp text, exactly as an inline meta block would be.

branches.json.label: All 2,015 AutoX/Ngern Chaiyo branches, per-branch compact record (x,y location + context counts + segment scores). The app's core branch layer, projected from the master.
branches.json.provenance: MIXED — location and context counts are MEASURED-structural; the per-branch segment scores are ESTIMATED composites, so this layer correctly classifies ESTIMATED. Shares one vintage with meta.json (both are projected in the same derive.py run).
branches.json.source: Projected from source-data/branches_final.json (the master). x,y coordinates, k10 buildings-within-10km (Overture), dfac DIW factories and dwork worker proxy are MEASURED; the per-segment scores (n/v/r/o/a/m/c/w) are DERIVED composites.

provinces/index.json.label: Province index — the 77-province directory (slug, Thai/English name, region, branch/district/factory/vehicle rollups).
provinces/index.json.provenance: measured — a directory/index of the 77 provinces with measured rollup counts; carries no modelled score.
provinces/index.json.source: A listing/index built by spatial join of amphoe polygons + branch point-in-polygon + the committed gov layers (factories_by_district, vehicles_by_province). Rollup counts are MEASURED.

*_catchment.json.generated_by: pipeline/pull_overture_buildings.py (network pull) then pipeline/bake_catchment_heights.py (type+footprint height model)
*_catchment.json.label: Per-province building-footprint catchment for the 3D city scenes (rayong-catchment.html?city=<slug>): every <slug>_catchment.json is an object-shaped {buildings,center} blob of extruded footprints.
*_catchment.json.provenance: ESTIMATED — building FOOTPRINT polygons + centroids are MEASURED (Overture Maps / OSM open building geometry), but per-building HEIGHT (h) and the FLOOR-AREA (fa) that drives the reachable-population read are ESTIMATED from building type + footprint area (OSM rarely tags real height in Thailand), so the layer classifies ESTIMATED — the same convention branches.json follows (measured geometry, estimated composite).
*_catchment.json.source: MEASURED Overture Maps / OSM building footprints pulled per province; heights baked by bake_catchment_heights.py's type+footprint model (ESTIMATED — the UI already footnotes 'heights estimated from type + footprint'). Object-shaped, network-pulled and re-pulled from the desktop, so provenance is carried in this sidecar rather than inline to avoid a {meta,data} restructure that the puller + 3D scenes would each have to change.
